description: Quarterly lube oil replenishment and vibration spectrum analysis.
findings: Drive-end bearing clearance measured 0.08 mm (nominal 0.04 - 0.06 mm). Minor bronze flaking observed in magnetic drain plug. Scheduled for bearing replacement on upcoming turnaround.

description: Inspection following low barrier fluid level alarm on Plan 53A pot.
findings: Primary silicon-carbide stationary face found cracked due to thermal shock. Replaced seal cartridge with John Crane Type 5620. Passed 6.0 bar nitrogen hold test with zero leakage.

description: Bently Nevada 3500 proximity probe vibration calibration and anti-surge stroke test.
findings: X-Y radial probes recalibrated. Anti-surge fast-opening time measured 1.1 seconds (compliant with <1.5s requirement). Zero shaft rub detected.

description: Diagnostic check on Fisher DVC6200 digital valve controller.
findings: Found instrument air regulator filter clogged with moisture and rust scale, dropping supply from 4.5 bar to 2.8 bar. Cleaned air filter and lubricated packing. Stroke response restored.
